article.title: Wikipedia Support Graph
article.subtitle: Public process and public progress for source-driven article support
article.para: This site publishes the public process behind a git-based knowledge graph for Wikipedia-supporting work on data technology topics.

section.title: Current focus
section.para: The first active topic is Collibra, treated both as a company and as a platform, with the work kept neutral, source-driven, and openly reviewable.
